nodes.name: lemma: cond
nodes.statement:
Under Assumptions assump: many weak moments and assump:omega, \\
    (i) There is $C>0$ with $|\beta- \beta_0|\leq C\sqrt{n} \|\bar g(\beta, \bm \eta_0)\| /\mu_n$ for all $\beta\in B$;\\
    (ii) There is $C>0$ and $\hat M=O_p(1)$ such that $|\beta-\beta_0|\leq C\sqrt{n}\|\hat g(\beta, \bm \eta_0) \| /\mu_n+ \hat M$ for all $\beta\in B$.

nodes.name: lemma: g bdd by beta
nodes.statement:
Under Assumptions assump: many weak moments and assump:omega, there is $C$ and $\hat M=O_p(1)$ such that for all $\beta', \beta\in B$,\\
(i)   $\sqrt{n} \|\bar g(\beta', \bm \eta_0) - \bar g(\beta, \bm \eta_0)\|/\mu_n\leq C|\beta'-\beta|$;\\
(ii)  $\sqrt{n} \|\hat g(\beta', \bm \eta_0) - \hat g(\beta, \bm \eta_0)\|/\mu_n\leq \hat M |\beta'-\beta|$.

nodes.name: lemma: Omega multiply
nodes.statement:
Under Assumption assump:omega, 
	$|a^T \{\Omega(\beta', \bm \eta_0)-\Omega(\beta, \bm \eta_0)\}b| \leq C\|a\|\|b\||\beta'-\beta|  $ for all $a, b \in \mathbb{R}^m$, $\beta', \beta\in B$.

nodes.name: lemma: sup g square
nodes.statement:
Under Assumption assump: moment and the boundedness of $ \bm{Z} $ and $ \bm{X} $, there is $ C>0 $ such that 
	\[
	 	\sup_{\beta\in B} E[\{g_i(\beta, \bm \eta_0)^T g_i(\beta, \bm \eta_0)\}^2]\leq Cm^2 .
	\]

nodes.name: lemma: Omega eta hat
nodes.statement:
Under Assumptions    assump: linear-assump:omega,   \\
	  (i) $ \|\hat\Omega(\beta_0,\hat {\bm \eta})- \Omega \| =O_p(\sqrt{m\log m/n}) + O_p(\sqrt{m^3(\log m)^2/n^2})$; \\
	  (ii) $   \|n^{-1} \sum_{i=1}^{n}g_i(\beta_0,\hat {\bm \eta}) G_i(\hat{\bm \eta})^T - E\{g_i G_i^T\} \|=O_p(\sqrt{m\log m/n}) + O_p(\sqrt{m^3(\log m)^2/n^2})$; \\
	  	  (iii) $    \|n^{-1} \sum_{i=1}^{n}G_i(\hat {\bm \eta}) G_i(\hat{\bm \eta})^T - E\{G_i G_i^T\} \| =O_p(\sqrt{m\log m/n}) + O_p(\sqrt{m^3(\log m)^2/n^2})$; \\ 
	  	  (iv) $ 	\sup_{\beta\in B} \|\hat\Omega(\beta,\hat {\bm \eta})- \Omega(\beta, \bm \eta_0)\| =O_p(\sqrt{m\log m/n}) + O_p(\sqrt{m^3(\log m)^2/n^2})$; \\
	  	 (v) $ 	\sup_{\beta\in B}  \|n^{-1} \sum_{i=1}^{n}g_i(\beta,\hat {\bm \eta}) G_i(\hat{\bm \eta})^T - E\{g_i(\beta,\bm \eta_0) G_i^T\} \| =O_p(\sqrt{m\log m/n}) + O_p(\sqrt{m^3(\log m)^2/n^2})$; \\

nodes.name: lemma:unif Q
nodes.statement: Under Assumptions assump: many weak moments-assump:omega, and  $ m^2/n\rightarrow 0 $,    $$ \sup_{\beta\in B} \mu_n^{-2} n  |\hat Q(\beta, \hat{\bm \eta}) - Q(\beta, \bm \eta_0) |= o_p(1).$$

nodes.name: lemma: Q tilde
nodes.statement:
Under Assumptions assump: many weak moments-assump: 4th moment,  and $ m^3/n\rightarrow 0  $, 
	   $$n\mu_n^{-1}\partial \hat Q(\beta, \hat{\bm \eta})/\partial \beta |_{\beta=\beta_0}=n\mu_n^{-1}\partial \tilde  Q(\beta, \hat{\bm \eta})/\partial \beta |_{\beta=\beta_0} +o_p(1).$$

nodes.name: lemma: Q second deriv
nodes.statement:
Under Assumptions assump: many weak moments-assump: 4th moment,  and $ m^3/n\rightarrow 0  $, 
\[
 n \mu_n^{-2}  \sup_{\beta\in B}  \left| \frac{\partial^2 \hat Q (\beta, \hat{\bm \eta})}{\partial \beta^2}-   \frac{\partial^2 \hat Q (\beta, \bm \eta_0)}{\partial \beta^2}  \right|  = o_p(1).
\]
